methods.name: accounts
methods.description: The user's social accounts: {accounts: [{id, account, network, handle, url}]}.

methods.name: feed
methods.description: The newest posts of the people and communities the user follows, newest first: {posts: [{id, account, network, author, handle, time, text, url, replies?, likes?, reposts?, media?: [{kind, url, alt}], reply_to?}], errors?}.

account.description: An account name from social.accounts (omitted: every account).

since.description: Only posts after this ISO date or time.

methods.name: notifications
methods.description: What happened around the user, newest first: {items: [{id, account, network, kind: mention|reply|like|repost|follow|other, from, handle, time, text?, post_id?}], errors?}.

account.description: An account name from social.accounts (omitted: every account).

unread.description: Only those not seen yet, where the network says so.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Public posts matching words, newest first: {posts: [{id, account, network, author, handle, time, text, url, replies?, likes?, reposts?, media?: [{kind, url, alt}], reply_to?}], errors?}. A community or tag can be in the query (Reddit: r/name, Mastodon and Bluesky: #tag).

account.description: An account name from social.accounts (omitted: every account).

methods.name: thread
methods.description: One post with its context and replies: {post: {id, account, network, author, handle, time, text, url, replies?, likes?, reposts?, media?: [{kind, url, alt}], reply_to?}, ancestors: [...], replies: [...]}.

id.description: A post id from feed, search or notifications (provider:…).

methods.name: post
methods.description: Publishes a post, or a reply with reply_to, from one account: {id, url}. Public and seen by others: always asked to the user first.

account.description: Which account posts (required without reply_to when there are several).

reply_to.description: A post id to answer (its account is used).

title.description: Reddit only: the title of a new post.

community.description: Reddit only: the subreddit of a new post (r/name).

methods.name: like
methods.description: Likes (favourites, upvotes) a post, or takes the like back with undo: true: {id, liked}.
